title: Coordinatewise sign-flip bijection
statement: For a natural number $r$ and a Boolean mask $\sigma$ on $r$ coordinates, the coordinatewise sign-flip map on sign-valued $r$-tuples sends $y_i$ to $-y_i$ when $\sigma(i)$ is true and leaves it unchanged otherwise; this map is a bijection.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $r$ specifying the number of coordinates
A Boolean mask on those coordinates
